mapper.select: -- Select active and inactive standard code groups for operation screens. SELECT scg.id AS standard_code_group_id, scg.group_code, scg.group_name, scg.source_name, scg.source_url, scg.version_label, scg.is_active AS active FROM standard_code_groups scg ORDER BY scg.is_active DESC, scg.group_code ASC
